cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA653, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10700m, squawk 3211. Now you are entering Wuhan Control area. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航653，从悉尼飞往武汉，巡航高度10700米，应答机3211。你现在正在进入武汉管制区域，与武汉区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，（高度）10700米，应答机3211。

cards.audioText: QFA653, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintaining 10700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，武汉区调，雷达识别，保持10700米。

cards.audioText: [You find thunderstorms building up near LKO, ask the controller how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现雷暴正在LKO附近形成，询问管制员，前机是如何避免天气的]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, thunderstorm near LKO, how did preceding aircraft avoid weather?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航635， LKO附近有雷暴，前机是如何避开天气的？

cards.audioText:
Preceding aircraft just deviate 5 miles to the east, what’s your intention?
[Tell ATC you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh:
前机向东偏航5海里，你的意图是什么?
[告诉管制员，你想向东偏航20海里来避开天气]
cards.referenceText: Request deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather, QFA653
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求向东偏航20海里来避开天气，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [You are approaching the top of the descent point, but there is CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你正在接近下降点的顶部，但是在较低高度层有积雨云，告知武汉区调，推迟下降]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于较低高度层有积雨云，请求推迟下降。

cards.audioText: [Now the thunderstorm is building up to the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult. Ask Wuhan Control to approach from the north and use ZF arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在，雷暴正在机场南部形成，通过LKO进场很困难，告诉武汉区调，从北部进近，使用ZF进场]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request approach from the north and use ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于雷暴，请求从北部进近，使用ZF进场。

cards.audioText: QFA653, turn right heading 020, expect ZF02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，右转航向020，预计ZF02进场程序。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF02 arrival, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向020，预计ZF02进场，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [Now there is small CBs in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在，你前方有一小团积雨云，请求在2海里内向右转]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles due CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于前方积雨云，请求2海里内右转。

cards.audioText: [During descent, your nose wheel is inoperative, inform Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell them you will stop on the runway after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在下降过程中，你的前轮失效，将情况通知武汉进场，并告诉他们你着陆后将在跑道上停下]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA653, nose wheel failed, request stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航653，前轮失效，请求着陆后在跑道上停下。

cards.audioText: [You are about to use the VOR/DME approach runway 22, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for ILS approach runway 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你将使用VOR/DME进近，跑道22，但是天气正在恶化。告诉武汉塔台，使用ILS进近，跑道18左]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, request ILS approach runway 18L due to weather deteriorating.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，由于天气恶化，请求ILS进近，跑道18左。

cards.audioText: [The approach lights is not bright enough, ask Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.]
cards.audioTextZh: 进近灯光不够亮，告诉塔台，提高进近灯光的亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, request brighten/turn up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，请求提高进近灯光亮度。

cards.audioText: [You are executing a missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 由于能见度差，你正在进行复飞，告知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，由于能见度差，复飞了。

cards.audioText: QFA653, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653， 按照标准复飞程序复飞。
cards.referenceText: Following the standard missed approach procedure, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序复飞，澳航653。

cards.audioText: QFA653, the visibility is improved now. Expect radar vector for another approach. Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，能见度现在提高了，预计雷达引导，再次进近，右转航向090，可以ILS（进近），跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS runway 18L, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，可以ILS（进近），跑道18左，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at Wuhan Airport, the tow truck is not in position. Ask for a tug.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在武汉机场，但是拖车未就位，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA653, tug not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航653，拖车未就位，请求拖车。
